audit.whatIsWrong: The page opened with the same 'reference assassin mirror' line used for every assassin and never named the mechanic that actually decides the lane: Ethereal Chains only roots if you stay shackled for 1.5 seconds.
audit.why: Riot E text: 'LeBlanc launches a chain that shackles the first enemy hit. If the target remains shackled for 1.5 seconds, LeBlanc roots them.' Living Shadow (650 range, 20s) is the tool that leaves inside that window. Chains is 925 range on 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11s.
audit.corrected: tldr, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d, loading and breakdown.cooldowns now key on the 1.5s shackle window and the swap that breaks it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer carried a blanket 'Skill' on rows 0,1,2,3,5,6 while content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read LeBlanc,LeBlanc,LeBlanc,LeBlanc,Zed,Zed,Zed.
audit.why: LeBlanc owns 1-5: Sigil of Malice is a 6s 700-range mark that any follow-up detonates, and Distortion returns her for free. Zed owns 6 onward once Death Mark plus the lethality item flips the burst race.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side Skill->LeBlanc and phases[5].side, [6].side Skill->Zed, one atomic group, with phases[0..3].why rewritten in the same proposal to state LeBlanc winning those rows — they had all been describing Zed's poke pattern under rows now owned by her. No win[N] edits: the content layer already matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three places attributed the decoy clone to Mimic (R): spikes[1].text 'Her R (Mimic) clone', mid 'her Mimic clone', wants.foe[2] 'Use R (Mimic) clone'. Mimic only recasts one of her basic spells.
audit.why: Riot R text: 'LeBlanc casts a mimicked version of one of her basic spells.' The clone is Mirror Image (passive): 'When LeBlanc drops below 40% Health, she becomes invisible for 1 second and creates a Mirror Image that deals no damage and lasts for up to 8 seconds.'
audit.corrected: All three now name Mirror Image and tie it to the 40% health trigger; dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.carry add the 1-second invisibility, which is the real reason a committed combo whiffs.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT) despite 'four-second return window' being spelled out in words.
audit.why: Distortion 15/13.75/12.5/11.25/10s with a 4-second return; Ethereal Chains 14/13.25/12.5/11.75/11s; Mimic 45/35/25s.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with all three as numerals and what each window permits.

notes: Main factual fix: the decoy clone was credited to Mimic (R) in three places. Mimic only recasts a basic spell; the clone is Mirror Image (passive), which also makes her invisible for 1 second when she drops below 40% health — that invisibility, not the clone, is why a committed Zed combo whiffs, and it is now stated. Second fix: Ethereal Chains only roots after 1.5 seconds of shackle, which was never mentioned anywhere on the page even though it is the counterplay Living Shadow exists for here. Level chart: the full layer was a blanket 'Skill' on six of seven rows against a content layer and packet that both read LeBlanc x4 then Zed x3; flipped all six sides as one atomic group and rewrote the four LeBlanc-side whys, which had been describing Zed's own poke pattern.
